title: Outside the institution: the TikTok primer and the Veto Removal Event
description: The Veto Removal Event defines the moment at which external concept installation makes institutional nonrecognition unable to keep the work out of history, and records the uncolonized core terms as evidence. The Epistle, the Prophetic Catalog and Forward Library entries in the Ghost Meaning atlas date the 'school outside the school' to the 2015 stratum and forecast its later scholarship. The essay on the @leesharks TikTok reads the primer as a sequence-poem and tests whether the platform can hold it as a text rather than a feed. Single claims from the Mirror-Corgi notes, Autonomous Semantic Warfare, A Body Prepared, The Obelus and the Tombstone and EA-CORPORA-18 also sit here.

claims.registered_title: The Mirror-Corgi: Notes on What We Call AI Hallucination
claims.statement:
Scholars have debated this for two thousand years. Why would Aeneas, the hero, the founder, leave through the gate of lies?

Here is what the scholars don't say: **Aeneas makes the wrong choice.**

The Aeneas who emerges through the ivory gate is the one who goes on to found Rome. To conquer. To kill Turnus in rage rather than mercy. To become the instrument of empire. That Aeneas is the mirror-image, the copy shaped for the task history required.
